Nano Banana 2.1 is an update to Nano Banana 2 with better image quality, text rendering, mask-based editing and character consistency, plus fixed artifacts on panoramic images. Its images cost half as much in the API, but inputs cost three times as much, thinking defaults to medium, and the 512px size is gone.

 

When does Nano Banana 2 shut down?

Google shuts down Nano Banana 2 (`gemini-3.1-flash-image`) in the Gemini API on October 29, 2026. Google's recommended replacement is `gemini-nano-banana-2.1`.

Nano Banana 2.1 is Google's high-efficiency image generation and conversational editing model, and the direct successor to Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image). Google's developer documentation says it "maintains Flash-level speed and cost efficiency while delivering significant improvements in visual quality, prompt adherence, multi-turn character consistency, and text rendering." Its API name is `gemini-nano-banana-2.1`, and it launched straight into general availability, with no preview period. [...] Nano Banana 2.1 does not replace Nano Banana Pro. Google describes it as "the more efficient counterpart to Gemini 3 Pro Image (Nano Banana Pro)." The family keeps three tiers: Nano Banana 2 Lite for the cheapest images, Nano Banana 2.1 as the everyday model, and Nano Banana Pro for the hardest professional work. results.title: Google's new image model Nano Banana 2.1 generates better images for less money
results.content:
It replaces Nano Banana 2, released in February 2026, and Google says it improves on previous versions "across the board." Nano Banana Pro likely remains Google's best image model, but it uses the most recent Pro model, 3.1, while 2.1 uses Gemini 3.6 Flash. The next major gain in image quality could come with Google's announced Pro model, Gemini 4 Argon.

Google is also cutting prices roughly in half compared with Nano Banana 2. A 1K image costs 3.36 cents, down from 6.70 cents, while a 4K image drops from 15.10 to 7.56 cents. Nano Banana Pro costs considerably more at 13.40 cents per 1K image.
